0.name: Dwight Fairfield
0.bio:
A nervous leader, able to locate his allies and increase their effectiveness.

His personal perks, Bond, Prove Thyself and Leader, allow him to get in proximity of other Survivors and provide bonuses to their actions as well as his own.

1.name: Meg Thomas
1.bio:
An energetic athlete, able to outrun most Killers.

Her personal perks, Quick & Quiet, Sprint Burst and Adrenaline, give her advantage to escape chases and put distance between herself and the Killer.

2.name: Claudette Morel
2.bio:
A studious botanist, able to boost her team's survivability as well as her own.

Her personal perks, Empathy, Botany Knowledge and Self Care, allow her to spot injured Survivors and heal her team and herself more effectively.

3.name: Jake Park
3.bio:
A solitary survivalist, able to hold his own in most situations.

His personal perks, Iron Will, Calm Spirit and Saboteur, allow him to more effectively move about the environment and survive while injured.

4.name: Nea Karlsson
4.bio:
An urban artist, able to easily escape and hide.

Her personal perks, Balanced Landing, Urban Evasion and Streetwise, make her well suited to completing objectives and rapid evasion.

5.name: Laurie Strode
5.bio:
A determined Survivor, prepared to weather any challenge.

Her personal perks, Sole Survivor, Object of Obsession and Decisive Strike, grant her powerful survival abilities at the cost of leaving her exposed.

6.name: Ace Visconti
6.bio:
A lucky gambler, improving the odds of the entire team.

His personal perks, Open Handed, Up the Ante and Ace in the Hole, boost the Luck of all Survivors and help with unlocking chests.

7.name: William "Bill" Overbeck
7.bio:
An old soldier, accustomed to dealing with critical situations.

His personal perks, Left Behind, Borrowed Time and Unbreakable, make him more powerful in dire moments.

8.name: Feng Min
8.bio:
An objective-focused competitor who can quickly adapt her strategy to meet a vast range of challenging situations.

Her personal perks, Technician, Lithe and Alert, help her with repairing generators and locating the Killer.

9.name: David King
9.bio:
A rugged scrapper, rewarding high-risk play.

His personal perks, We're Gonna Live Forever, Dead Hard and No Mither, reward an aggressive, confrontational playstyle but leave him vulnerable.

10.name: Kate Denson
10.bio:
A hopeful songbird, able to make the most of her surroundings.

Her personal perks, Dance With Me, Windows of Opportunity and Boil Over, grant her the foresight and feistiness to escape even the most dire situations.

11.name: Quentin Smith
11.bio:
A resolute dreamwalker, increasing the survivability and recovery of his team.

His personal perks, Wake Up!, Pharmacy and Vigil, help Survivors locate exit gates and recover more easily.

12.name: Detective Tapp
12.bio:
An obsessed detective, able to locate and complete objectives faster.

His personal perks, Tenacity, Detective's Hunch and Stake Out, make him objective-focused and able to rapidly recover.

13.name: Adam Francis
13.bio:
A resourceful teacher, able to adapt to new circumstances and develop strategies accordingly.

His personal perks, Diversion, Deliverance and Autodidact, help him to distract The Killer, survive desperate situations, and become more skilled as the trial continues.

14.name: Jeff Johansen
14.bio:
A quiet artist, standing steadfast against impossible odds.

His personal perks, Breakdown, Aftercare and Distortion, give him observational advantages and help to hide his presence from The Killer.

15.name: Jane Romero
15.bio:
An influential celebrity, going against the grain to tackle challenges head on.

Her personal perks, Solidarity, Poised and Head On, give her a flexible skillset that allow her to help others, as well as herself, to escape dangerous situations.

16.name: Ashley J. Williams
16.bio:
An "alone wolf," cocky and headstrong; a man built for survival.

His personal perks, Flip-Flop, Buckle Up and Mettle of Man, give him additional resilience to pain and hardship, as well as the ability to help his friends out of sticky situations.

17.name: Nancy Wheeler
17.bio:
An aspiring journalist, able to make acute observations and gain insights that others may miss.

Her perks, Better Together, Fixated, and Inner Strength, give her the information and courage she needs to tackle unexpected challenges.

18.name: Steve Harrington
18.bio:
A former jock, able to protect and support his fellow Survivors while providing his own brand of humor.

His perks, Babysitter, Camaraderie, and Second Wind, enable him to distract Killers, tolerate pain, and get back into the fight.

19.name: Yui Kimura
19.bio:
A hardened street racer, able to gain advantages for her and her fellow Survivors in challenging situations.

Her personal perks, Lucky Break, Any Means Necessary and Breakout, enable her to cover her blood trails, reset dropped pallets, and assist helpless Survivors.

20.name: Zarina Kassir
20.bio:
A plucky documentarian, able to use her street smarts to avoid detection and greatly assist other Survivors.

Her personal perks, Off The Record, Red Herring and For the People, help her remain hidden in the face of danger, create distractions, and quickly heal others by forgoing her own safety.

21.name: Cheryl Mason
21.bio:
Cheryl Mason is a young veteran of terror, emboldening both herself and her team.

Her personal perks, Soul Guard, Blood Pact, and Repressed Alliance, allow her to survive through immense hardship, stay in contact with team members, and plan objectives.

22.name: Felix Richter
22.bio:
A visionary architect, able to use his relentless determination to form a plan and help other Survivors.

His personal perks, Visionary, Desperate Measures, and Built to Last, help him reveal generators, rescue Survivors, and get the most from his tools.

23.name: Élodie Rakoto
23.bio:
An occult investigator, able to use cunning tricks and stubborn resolve to keep herself alive.

Her personal perks, Appraisal, Deception, and Power Struggle, allow her to interact with objects in new ways, all while having a backup plan to escape Killers.

24.name: Lee Yun-jin
24.bio:
A self-interested music producer, able to advance her goals during turbulent times.

Her personal perks, Fast Track, Smash Hit, and Self-Preservation, allow her to improve her abilities when others are harmed, and quickly escape from a chase.

25.name: Jill Valentine
25.bio:
Jill Valentine is a founding member of S.T.A.R.S. who has triumphed over countless bio-organic weapons.

Her personal perks, Counterforce, Resurgence, and Blast Mine, allow her to indirectly fight back, while offering strong support to her teammates.

26.name: Leon S. Kennedy
26.bio:
Leon S. Kennedy is a rookie police officer who went beyond the call of duty during the outbreak in Raccoon City.

His personal perks, Bite the Bullet, Flashbang, and Rookie Spirit, allow him to ignore pain, disorient the Killer, and track objectives being lost.

27.name: Mikaela Reid
27.bio:
Mikaela is a young mystic, able to alter the trial with supernatural abilities.

Her personal perks, Clairvoyance, Boon: Circle of Healing, and Boon: Shadow Step, allow her to oversee the area while creating places of refuge.

28.name: Jonah Vasquez
28.bio:
Jonah is a mathematical mastermind, able to use logic to help his team.

His personal perks, Overcome, Corrective Action, and Boon: Exponential allow him to quickly flee, correct failed skill checks, and treat dying Survivors.

29.name: Yoichi Asakawa
29.bio:
Yoichi is a brilliant marine biologist and psychic whose knowledge and abilities allow him to protect himself and assist others.

His personal perks, Parental Guidance, Empathic Connection, and Boon: Dark Theory allow him to hide from Killers, call out to injured Survivors, and help others move faster.

30.name: Haddie Kaur
30.bio:
Haddie is a brave and determined podcaster with the ability to see and feel places of great suffering she calls Overlaps.

Her personal perks, Inner Focus, Residual Manifest, and Overzealous allow her to track Survivors and Killers after an attack, use Flashlights more effectively, and repair generators more efficiently.

31.name: Ada Wong
31.bio:
Ada Wong is a mysterious secret agent whose skill in espionage makes her a dangerous foe.

Her personal perks, Wiretap, Reactive Healing, and Low Profile allow her to spy on a Killer, gain a surge of healing when her allies are hurt, and leave no trace when she is the final Survivor.

32.name: Rebecca Chambers
32.bio:
Rebecca Chambers is a gifted medic and squad member whose presence soothes those around her.

Her personal perks, Better Than New, Reassurance, and Hyperfocus allow her to give her teammates speed boosts, give temporary relief to struggling allies, and complete skill checks at increased speed.

33.name: Vittorio Toscano
33.bio:
Vittorio has endlessly wandered through the Fog, attempting to learn its secrets, for ages.

His personal perks, Potential Energy, Fogwise, and Quick Gambit allow him to store generator progress to use later, reveal the Killer's location after a great Skill Check, and give others a speed boost while repairing.

34.name: Thalita Lyra
34.bio:
Thalita has mastered the art of competitive flair, fighting kites with skill and flourish.

Her personal perks, Cut Loose, Friendly Competition, and Teamwork: Power of Two allow her to perform a series of fast vaults, inspire faster generator repair from teammates, and help allies move faster after they are healed by you.

35.name: Renato Lyra
35.bio:
Renato always keeps his eye on the prize, and he expects the same from his teammates.

His personal perks, Background Player, Blood Rush, and Teamwork: Collective Stealth allow him to move faster when near a chase, recover from Exhausted instantly, and hide your and an allies' scratch marks after that ally heals you.

36.name: Gabriel Soma
36.bio:
A resourceful engineer, ready to make the most out of any situation.

His personal perks, Troubleshooter, Made For This and Scavenger, help him see things during a chase, gain Endurance after healing Survivors, and recharge his toolbox.

37.name: Nicolas Cage
37.bio:
Nicolas Cage is a superstar, trapped in the role of a lifetime.

His personal perks, Dramaturgy, Scene Partner and Plot Twist, help him make a quick escape, see the Killer’s aura, and pretend to be dying.

38.name: Ellen Ripley
38.bio:
Ellen Ripley, Warrant Officer of the Nostromo, is capable and pragmatic.

Her personal perks, Lucky Star, Chemical Trap, and Light-footed let her hide her pools of blood and grunts of pain, slow Killers with trapped pallets, and run silently.

39.name: Alan Wake
39.bio:
Alan Wake, bestselling author, knows what it means to push back the darkness.

His perks, Champion of Light, Boon: Illumination, and Deadline, make Flashlights more powerful, reveal chests and generators, and create more frequent Skill Checks.

40.name: Sable Ward
40.bio:
Sable is not afraid to embrace the darkness, or the power that lies within it.

Her personal perks, Invocation: Weaving Spiders, Strength in Shadows, and Wicked allow her to quicken repair progress, heal herself without a Med-kit, and escape the basement hooks.

41.name: Aestri Yazar
41.bio:
Aestri, fellow bard Baermar, and their troupe never back down from any adventure.

Their personal perks, Mirrored Illusion, Bardic Inspiration, and Still Sight allow them to create illusions, help others repair generators quicker, and see nearby Killers, generators, and chests.

42.name: Lara Croft
42.bio:
Lara Croft's instincts have been honed by her many dangerous expeditions.

Her personal perks, Finesse, Specialist, and Hardened allow her to reveal the killer instead of screaming, repair generators more efficiently, and fast vault faster.

43.name: Trevor Belmont
43.bio:
Trevor Belmont, vampire hunter, knows his destiny is to vanquish evil.

His personal perks, Eyes of Belmont, Exultation, and Moment of Glory, allow him to see the Killer's aura, increase an item's rarity, and heal one health state.

44.name: Taurie Cain
44.bio:
Taurie Cain was raised as a Disciple of the Black Talon, condemned to be a sacrifice.

Her personal perks, Invocation: Treacherous Crows, Clean Break, and Shoulder the Burden, allow her to reveal the Killer's aura, heal after being Broken, and take on another Survivor’s hook state.

45.name: Orela Rose
45.bio:
Orela Rose is a paramedic with a love for horror and a calming demeanor.

Her personal perks, Do No Harm, Duty of Care, and Rapid Response, allow her to heal Survivors faster, give Haste to other Survivors, and see the Killer’s aura upon gaining Exhausted.

46.name: Rick Grimes
46.bio:
Rick Grimes is the leader of a group of post-apocalyptic survivors.

His personal perks, Apocalyptic Ingenuity, Come and Get Me!, and Teamwork: Toughen Up, allow him to remake broken pallets, help vulnerable teammates, and be discreet when injured.

47.name: Michonne Grimes
47.bio:
Michonne Grimes is a relentless protector living in a community of post-apocalyptic survivors.

Her personal perks, Conviction, Last Stand, and Teamwork: Throw Down allow her to make one last push after being downed, stun the Killer with a fast vault, and empower other Survivors after a tense chase.

48.name: Vee Boonyasak
48.bio:
Vee Boonyasak is an energetic drummer whose adventurous nature led to a doomed concert.

Her personal perks, Road Life, ONE-TWO-THREE-FOUR!, and Ghost Notes allow her to leverage repair work into faster healing, strengthen allies' ability to repair and heal, and recover from Exhausted faster.

49.name: Dustin Henderson
49.bio:
Dustin Henderson is a brilliant and somewhat nerdy high school student.

His personal perks, Bada Bada Boom, Change of Plan, and Teamwork: Full Circuit allow him to slow down Killers, pivot his strategy mid-trial, and safely repair generators.

50.name: Eleven
50.bio:
Eleven is a former test subject with extrasensory abilities.

Her personal perks, Extrasensory Perception, We See You, and Teamwork: Soft-Spoken allow her to scout the area, reveal the Killer's aura, and reduce the noise of generators.

51.name: Kwon Tae-young
51.bio:
Kwon Tae-young is a hard-working perfectionist who does not rest until he gets results.

His personal perks, Flow State, A Place For Us, and Five Moves Ahead allow him to ramp up his efficiency as generators are completed; heal others, especially the Obsession, covertly; and make more informed decisions when within the Killer's Terror Radius.

52.name: Shane Wiigwaas
52.bio:
Shane Wiigwaas follows his own road, hoping to atone for his past mistakes.

His personal perks, Wide Open Throttle, Lend a Hand, and Cross-Examination, allow him to reset dropped pallets, give permanent healing charges, and see Light Marks left behind by the Killer.

53.name: Aurora Stardotter
53.bio:
Aurora Stardotter is viewed as a savior to her people and gains insight into the future by reading the stars.

Her personal perks, Fruits of Your Labor, Salvation's Cry, and Boon: Steadfast, allow for special advantages when completing Generators, strategic coordination during chases, and efficient Generator repairs.

268435456.name: The Trapper
268435456.bio:
An area-control Killer, able to apply pressure across the map by placing deadly Bear Traps for Survivors to step in.

His personal perks, Unnerving Presence, Brutal Strength and Agitation, allow him to chase and carry Survivors more effectively.

268435457.name: The Wraith
268435457.bio:
A stealth Killer, able to Cloak and Uncloak at the ringing of his Wailing Bell.

His personal perks, Predator, Bloodhound and Shadowborn, give him extra abilities to track and locate Survivors, making him a very efficient hunter.

268435458.name: The Hillbilly
268435458.bio:
A high-mobility Killer, able to cover large distances in a short amount of time and instantly down Survivors using his Chainsaw.

His personal perks, Enduring, Lightborn and Tinkerer, allow him to enhance his power and make him harder to lose during chases.

268435459.name: The Nurse
268435459.bio:
A warping Killer, able to Blink through obstacles and quickly close gaps with her power, Spencer's Last Breath.

Her personal perks, Stridor, Thanatophobia and A Nurse's Calling, allow her to decrease Survivor abilities and track them when they are injured.

268435460.name: The Hag
268435460.bio:
A cursed Killer, able to place traps and then Teleport to them when activated, using her Blackened Catalyst.

Her personal perks, Hex: The Third Seal, Hex: Ruin and Hex: Devour Hope, apply crippling penalties to Survivors as long as the Totem they are attached to remains uncleansed.

268435461.name: The Shape
268435461.bio:
A haunting Killer who stalks Survivors to feed his power.

His personal perks, Save the Best for Last, Play with your Food and Dying Light select one Survivor to become the Obsession and trigger deadly effects based on the Obsession's status.

268435462.name: The Doctor
268435462.bio:
A madness-inducing Killer who is able to use his power, Carter's Spark, to trigger electrical charges, incapacitating Survivors and eventually causing them to hallucinate and scream in terror, revealing their position.

His personal perks, Overwhelming Presence, Monitor & Abuse and Overcharge, encourage chases, impact Survivors' ability to repair effectively, and make him harder to detect when not in a chase.

268435463.name: The Huntress
268435463.bio:
A ranged Killer, able to throw Hunting Hatchets at Survivors to injure them from a distance.

Her personal perks, Beast of Prey, Territorial Imperative and Hex: Huntress Lullaby, allow her to apply pressure through better map awareness and enhanced chasing abilities.

268435464.name: The Cannibal
268435464.bio:
A chainsaw-wielding Killer, able to trigger a deadly frenzy using Bubba's Chainsaw, immediately downing anyone in its path.

His personal perks, Knock Out, Barbecue & Chili and Franklin's Demise, make Survivors easier to locate while robbing them of their tools and abilities.

268435465.name: The Nightmare
268435465.bio:
A nightmare inducing Killer, passively forcing Survivors into his Dream World using his power, Dream Demon. It is here that Survivors become extremely vulnerable to his dream abilities. Using his Dream Projection ability he is able to quickly appear across the map and put pressure on Survivors.

His personal perks, Fire Up, Remember Me and Blood Warden, improve his abilities over time and make him stronger as the trial reaches its climax.

268435466.name: The Pig
268435466.bio:
A tormenting Killer, able to Crouch into stealth mode, then Ambush Survivors from a short distance. She can also apply Reverse Bear Traps to downed Survivors, forcing them to remove it before the timer runs out. If the timer expires, they die instantly.

Her personal perks, Hangman's Trick, Surveillance and Make Your Choice, give her more map control and expose altruistic Survivors.

268435467.name: The Clown
268435467.bio:
A strategic Killer, able to control and corral Survivors by throwing bottles of The Afterpiece Tonic to create clouds of noxious gas that cover large areas for a short amount of time. Survivors Intoxicated by the gas are inflicted with impaired vision and movement speed, and give away their location by coughing loudly.

His personal perks, Bamboozle, Coulrophobia and Pop Goes the Weasel, provide vaulting advantages and negatively impact Survivor healing speed and repairs.

268435468.name: The Spirit
268435468.bio:
A phase-walking Killer, able to catch Survivors off-guard with her traversal power, Yamaoka’s Haunting. Her power allows her to Teleport from one place to another without being seen.

Her personal perks, Spirit Fury, Hex: Haunted Ground and Rancor, give her tools to observe and bait Survivors, and deal with obstacles directly in her path.

268435469.name: The Legion
268435469.bio:
A band of merciless Killers, able to rushdown helpless Survivors with their power, Feral Frenzy. Attacks made during their frenzy inflict lingering internal damage, downing any Survivors that are not quick enough to react.

Their personal perks, Discordance, Mad Grit and Iron Maiden, give them the ability to locate their prey and attack savagely while transporting Survivors to the hook.

268435470.name: The Plague
268435470.bio:
A devout Killer, able to infect Survivors from a short distance using her power, Vile Purge. Survivors inflicted by this contamination risk becoming injured or broken, unless they find a way to cure themselves in a Pool of Devotion.

Her personal perks, Corrupt Intervention, Infectious Fright and Dark Devotion, give her the ability to hinder Survivor objectives, while simultaneously confusing and frightening those within her presence.

268435471.name: The Ghost Face
268435471.bio:
A creepy Killer, able to Stalk his victims and sneak up silently using his power, Night Shroud. Affected Survivors will find themselves vulnerable and oblivious to his presence and must use all of their perception and awareness to protect themselves from his approach.

His personal perks, I'm All Ears, Thrilling Tremors and Furtive Chase, give him the ability to locate Survivors, defend generators, and make his chases unpredictable.

268435472.name: The Demogorgon
268435472.bio:
An unidentified Killer, able to open multiple Portals and traverse between them to cover large distances. Using its power, Of the Abyss, it can detect any Survivors within a close proximity to the Portals then unleash a leaping attack to inflict damage from a distance.

Its perks, Surge, Cruel Limits, and Mindbreaker, impact the environment close to generators and affect nearby Survivors in unexpected ways.

268435473.name: The Oni
268435473.bio:
A monstrous Killer, able to absorb the blood energy of his injured foes, and then use that energy to transform into a brutal demon. Using his power, Yamaoka's Wrath, he can rush down Survivors at great speed and deal deadly strikes with his kanabō.

His personal perks, Zanshin Tactics, Blood Echo and Nemesis, provide navigational information, punish injured Survivors, and gain advantages over those that interfere.

268435474.name: The Deathslinger
268435474.bio:
A vengeful Killer, able to spear Survivors from a distance and Reel them in using his power, The Redeemer.

His personal perks, Gear Head, Dead Man’s Switch, and Hex: Retribution, allow him to locate and impede Survivor objectives, and punish Survivors for destroying Totems.

268435475.name: The Executioner
268435475.bio:
A map-manipulation Killer, able to torment Survivors with the hazards he creates. Affected Survivors will be vulnerable to his special hook, the Cage of Atonement, and his unique mori, Final Judgment.

His personal perks, Forced Penance, Trail of Torment, and Deathbound, allow him to aggressively pursue his prey while deceiving and tracking Survivors.

268435476.name: The Blight
268435476.bio:
An unpredictable Killer, able to rush forward in a burst of speed and carom off obstacles to injure Survivors using his power, Blighted Corruption.

His personal perks, Dragon's Grip, Hex: Undying, and Hex: Blood Favor allow him to impose powerful effects on generators, Totems, and pallets.

268435477.name: The Twins
268435477.bio:
A cooperative pair of Killers, able to divide and hunt together using their power, Blood Bond.

Their personal perks, Hoarder, Oppression, and Coup de Grâce allow them to monitor Survivors’ actions, impede their progress, and hunt more effectively.

268435478.name: The Trickster
268435478.bio:
A ranged Killer, able to quickly unleash a flurry of blades by using his power, Showstopper.

His personal perks, Starstruck, Hex: Crowd Control, and No Way Out, allow him to quickly down would-be rescuers and block areas of the environment to his advantage.

268435479.name: The Nemesis
268435479.bio:
An unrelenting Killer, capable of attacking at mid-range with his tentacle, while receiving support from Zombies roaming the area.

His personal perks, Lethal Pursuer, Hysteria, and Eruption, allow him to quickly ambush Survivors, while sowing confusion and fear when injuring and hooking them.

268435480.name: The Cenobite
268435480.bio:
A summoning Killer, able to possess chain projectiles and use the Lament Configuration to torture every Survivor at once.

His personal perks, Deadlock, Hex: Plaything, and Scourge Hook: Gift of Pain, allow him to slow generator progress and continue to torment Survivors who have experienced his sweet suffering.

268435481.name: The Artist
268435481.bio:
A ranged-reconnaissance Killer, able to launch Dire Crows across the map to reveal and attack Survivors.

Her personal perks, Grim Embrace, Scourge Hook: Pain Resonance, and Hex: Pentimento allow her to interrupt Survivor objectives, torment hooked Survivors, and use destroyed Totems to her advantage.

268435482.name: The Onryō
268435482.bio:
A vengeful ghost imbued with the power of Nensha, the Onryō is able to silently and invisibly traverse the realm, manifesting when she is ready to strike.

Her personal perks, Scourge Hook: Floods Of Rage, Call Of Brine, and Merciless Storm allow her to expose hidden Survivors, surveil generators, and hamper repair progress.

268435483.name: The Dredge
268435483.bio:
A manifestation of the dark thoughts of a once-vibrant community, the Dredge is able to teleport between lockers and summon an overwhelming darkness.

Its personal perks, Dissolution, Darkness Revealed, and Septic Touch allow it to destroy pallets, spot Survivors near lockers, and afflict healing Survivors with Blindness and Exhausted.

268435484.name: The Mastermind
268435484.bio:
Albert Wesker is a brilliant and ruthless mastermind infused with the power of Uroboros.

His personal perks, Superior Anatomy, Awakened Awareness, and Terminus allow you to vault faster, see other Survivor's auras while carrying one, and cause Survivors to be permanently Broken when the exit gates are powered.

268435485.name: The Knight
268435485.bio:
The Knight is a strategic Killer, able to send his faithful Guards to hunt for Survivors and damage objects on the battlefield.

His personal perks, Nowhere to Hide, Hex: Face the Darkness, and Hubris allow him to reveal Survivors near generators, curse Survivors to scream out in fear, and cause a Survivor who stuns you to become Exposed.

268435486.name: The Skull Merchant
268435486.bio:
The Skull Merchant is a tactical Killer, able to place Drones that detect and debilitate her targets.

Her personal perks, Game Afoot, THWACK!, and Leverage allow her to gain Haste from pursuing your Obsession, force screams from Survivors when breaking walls or pallets, and reduce Survivors' heal speed the more times you place them on hooks.

268435487.name: The Singularity
268435487.bio:
The Singularity is a relentless Killer, able to launch Biopods to move quickly across the map.

His personal perks, Genetic Limits, Forced Hesitation, and Machine Learning allow him to Exhaust newly injured Survivors, Hinder anyone close to a Survivor put in the dying state, and compromise generators.

268435488.name: The Xenomorph
268435488.bio:
A relentless specimen from a distant planet, The Xenomorph is vicious, agile, and cunning.

Its personal perks, Ultimate Weapon, Rapid Brutality, and Alien Instinct allow it to cause nearby Survivors to scream, gain Haste after basic attacks, and see auras of faraway Survivors.

268435489.name: The Good Guy
268435489.bio:
The Good Guy is an elusive Killer, capable of deceiving Survivors with his illusory Footfalls and deadly Slice & Dice.

His personal perks, Hex: Two Can Play, Friends 'til the End, and Batteries Included, allow him to blind those who blind him, relentlessly hunt his Obsession, and get faster around completed generators.

268435490.name: The Unknown
268435490.bio:
A being beyond understanding, though many have tried.

Its personal perks, Unbound, Unforeseen, and Undone allow it to move quicker, put its Terror Radius on a generator, and deplete generator progress.

268435491.name: The Lich
268435491.bio:
Few dare speak The Lich's true name, for fear that he may hear... or worse.

His personal perks, Weave Attunement, Languid Touch, and Dark Arrogance allow him to exploit used items, exhaust those who disturb the crows, and increase vault speed.

268435492.name: The Dark Lord
268435492.bio:
The Dark Lord, Dracula, is the embodiment of darkness and tragedy.

His personal perks, Hex: Wretched Fate, Human Greed, and Dominance, allow him to slow the Obsession's repair speed, see the auras of unopened chests, and block chests and totems.

268435493.name: The Houndmaster
268435493.bio:
The Houndmaster is a force to be feared, with an equally fearsome dog at her side.

Her personal perks, All-Shaking Thunder, Scourge Hook: Jagged Compass, and No Quarter, help her increase her lunge attack distance, create scourge hooks, and overwhelm Survivors with healing Skill Checks.

268435494.name: The Ghoul
268435494.bio:
The Ghoul has been pushed to his limits and he’s hungry for more.

His personal perks, Hex: Nothing But Misery, Forever Entwined, and None Are Free, help him Hinder Survivors, hook Survivors more quickly, and block pallets when all generators are completed.

268435495.name: The Animatronic
268435495.bio:
The Animatronic always comes back.

His personal perks, Help Wanted, Phantom Fear, and Haywire, help him compromise generators, make Survivors scream, and regress exit gate switches.

268435496.name: The Krasue
268435496.bio:
A shape-changing Killer, able to inflict Survivors with an effect that weakens them to her Intestinal Whip attack.

Her personal perks, Ravenous, Wandering Eye, and Hex: Overture of Doom help her increase mid-trial pressure, spot injured Survivors, and cause confusion to her whereabouts.

268435497.name: The First
268435497.bio:
The First is a cunning and cruel former test subject, whose powers were sharpened in an alternate dimension.

His personal perks, Turn Back The Clock, Secret Project, and Hex: Hive Mind allow him to damage distant generators, block them from repair, and set them back when another is completed.

268435498.name: The Slasher
268435498.bio:
The Slasher is the embodiment of horror, a relentless Killer who is always on the hunt.

His personal perks, Hex: Scared to Death, Silent Shadow, and Rampage, allow him to excel at chases, stealthily hunt Survivors, and recover after being stunned.

268435499.name: The Judgment
268435499.bio:
The Judgment enforces the will of The Creators with Its Divine Light.

Its personal perks, Celestial Witness, Hex: Under Your Thumb, and Lay Waste, allow It to track the Obsession, limit and surveil Survivors with Haste, and increase generator regression.

Ace_In_The_Hole.name: Ace in the Hole
Ace_In_The_Hole.description:
Whenever you loot an item from a Chest, it will have:
  • A Visceral or lower rarity add-on.
  • {Tunable.S07P03.ModifyChestItemSecondAddonChance%}% chance for an Uncommon or lower rarity add-on.


When you escape, you keep your add-ons.

Adrenaline.name: Adrenaline
Adrenaline.description:
When all Generators are completed, if you are downed or injured, heal instantly. Then, ignoring {Keyword.Exhausted}:
  • You gain {Tunable.S02P03.Haste%}% {Keyword.Haste} for {Tunable.S02P03.HasteDuration}s.
  • You gain {Keyword.Exhausted} for {Tunable.S02P03.ExhaustionDuration}s.

Aftercare.name: Aftercare
Aftercare.description:
You and up to {Tunable.S15P02.MaxSurvivors} Survivors see each other's Auras whenever:
  • You unhook them, or they unhook you.
  • You finish healing them, or they finish healing you.


This effect lasts until you are hooked.

Agitation.name: Agitation
Agitation.description:
While carrying a Survivor:
  • You gain {Tunable.K01P03.Haste%}% {Keyword.Haste}.
  • Your Terror Radius is {Tunable.K01P03.TerrorRadiusIncreaseSize}m larger.

Alert.name: Alert
Alert.description:
Whenever the Killer breaks a Pallet or Breakable Wall, or damages a Generator:
  • You hear a sound cue.
  • You see their Aura for {Tunable.S09P03.AuraRevealDuration}s.

AnyMeansNecessary.name: Any Means Necessary
AnyMeansNecessary.description:
While next to a Dropped Pallet, use {Input.ActivatableButton1} for {Tunable.S20P02.ActionTimeRequired}s to reset it.

You see the Auras of Dropped Pallets.

Autodidact.name: Autodidact
Autodidact.description:
You start the trial with {Tunable.S14P03.StartingTokens} Tokens, up to {Tunable.S14P03.MaxToken}, and your good basic healing Skill Checks give {Tunable.S14P03.InitialProgressionPenalty%}% less progress.

While healing another Survivor without a Med-Kit:
  • Whenever you hit a basic Skill Check, you earn {Tunable.S14P03.TokensPerSkillCheck} token.
  • Whenever you hit a basic Skill Check, for each Token, you gain {Tunable.S14P03.ProgressionBonusPerToken%}% more progress.
  • You cannot get great basic Skill Checks.

Babysitter.name: Babysitter
Babysitter.description:
Whenever you unhook a Survivor:
  • They gain {Tunable.S18P01.Haste%}% {Keyword.Haste} for {Tunable.S18P01.HasteDuration}s.
  • They leave no Pools of Blood for {Tunable.S18P01.StealthDuration}s.
  • They leave no Scratch Marks for {Tunable.S18P01.StealthDuration}s.
  • You see the Killer's Aura for {Tunable.S18P01.AuraRevealDuration}s.

Balanced_Landing.name: Balanced Landing
Balanced_Landing.description:
Whenever you fall from at least {Tunable.S05P01.RequiredFallHeight}m:
  • You gain {Tunable.S05P01.Haste%}% {Keyword.Haste} for {Tunable.S05P01.HasteDuration}s.
  • You gain {Keyword.Exhausted} for {Tunable.S05P01.ExhaustionDuration}s.
  • Your stagger is {Tunable.S05P01.FallStaggerReduction%}% shorter.
  • Your Grunts from falling are {Tunable.S05P01.FallGruntReduction%}% quieter.

Bamboozle.name: Bamboozle
Bamboozle.description:
Whenever you vault a Window, it is blocked for Survivors for {Tunable.K12P01.WindowBlockDurations}s.

You basic-vault Windows {Tunable.K12P01.WindowVaultSpeed%}% faster.

Only 1 Window can be blocked at a time.

BBQAndChilli.name: Barbecue & Chili
BBQAndChilli.description: Whenever you hook a Survivor, for {Tunable.K09P02.AuraRevealDuration}s, you see the Auras of all Survivors who are at least {Tunable.K09P02.MinDistanceFromHook}m away from the hooked Survivor.

BeastOfPrey.name: Beast of Prey
BeastOfPrey.description: Whenever you gain Bloodlust, gain {Keyword.Undetectable} for {Tunable.K08P01.UndetectableDuration}s.

BetterTogether.name: Better Together
BetterTogether.description:
While you are repairing a Generator:
  • Other Survivors see that Generator's Aura.
  • Whenever the Killer downs a Survivor, you see the Auras of all Survivors for {Tunable.S19P01.AuraRevealDuration}s.

Bitter_Murmur.name: Bitter Murmur
Bitter_Murmur.description:
Whenever a Generator is completed, you see the Auras of Survivors within {Tunable.KG_Bitter_Murmur.AuraRevealRange}m of it for {Tunable.KG_Bitter_Murmur.AuraRevealDuration}s.

When all Generators are completed, you see the Auras of all Survivors for {Tunable.KG_Bitter_Murmur.AuraRevealEndgameDuration}s.

BloodEcho.name: Blood Echo
BloodEcho.description:
Whenever you hook a Survivor, for {Tunable.K18P02.HemorrhageExhaustionDuration}s, all injured Survivors:
  • Gain {Keyword.Exhausted}.
  • Gain {Keyword.Hemorrhage}.

BloodHound.name: Bloodhound
BloodHound.description: Pools of Blood are brighter and last {Tunable.K02P02.ExtraTrackDuration}s longer.

BloodPact.name: Blood Pact
BloodPact.description:
While you are not the Obsession:
  • While you or the Obsession are injured, you see each other's Auras.
  • Whenever you finish healing the Obsession, or they finish healing you, while within {Tunable.S22P02.RequiredDistance}m of each other, you both gain {Tunable.S22P02.Haste%}% {Keyword.Haste}.


While you are the Obsession, if you are hooked, another Survivor becomes the Obsession.

When the trial starts, you are less likely to be the Obsession.

BloodWarden.name: Blood Warden
BloodWarden.description:
When an Exit Gate is opened, once per trial, when you hook a Survivor, both Exits are blocked for {Tunable.K10P03.GateBlockDuration}s.

You see the Auras of Survivors within Exit Thresholds.

BoilOver.name: Boil Over
BoilOver.description:
While carried by the Killer:
  • Whenever the Killer falls from at least {Tunable.S13P03.RequiredFallHeight}m, you gain {Tunable.S13P03.FallExtraWiggle%}% of your current wiggle progress.
  • Your wiggle is {Tunable.S13P03.WiggleIntensity%}% stronger.
  • Within {Tunable.S13P03.HookAuraBlockRange}m, the Killer cannot see Hook Auras.

Bond.name: Bond
Bond.description: Within {Tunable.S01P01.AuraRevealDistance}m, you see other Survivors' Auras.

BoonDestroyer.name: Shattered Hope
BoonDestroyer.description:
Whenever you snuff a Boon Totem, it is destroyed.

Whenever a Totem is blessed, cleansed or destroyed:
  • Dull Totems are blocked for {Tunable.KG_Shattered_Hope.EffectDuration}s.
  • Hex Totems are blocked for {Tunable.KG_Shattered_Hope.EffectDuration}s.
  • See Boon Totems' Auras for {Tunable.KG_Shattered_Hope.EffectDuration}s.

BorrowedTime.name: Borrowed Time
BorrowedTime.description:
Whenever you unhook a Survivor:
  • They retain their unhook {Keyword.Endurance} for {Tunable.S08P02.EnduranceExtraDuration}s longer.
  • They retain their unhook {Keyword.Haste} for {Tunable.S08P02.HasteExtraDuration}s longer.

Breakdown.name: Breakdown
Breakdown.description:
Whenever you are unhooked:
  • The Hook breaks, then is repaired after {Tunable.S15P01.HookRespawnTime}s.
  • You see the Killer's Aura for {Tunable.S15P01.AuraRevealDuration}s.

Breakout.name: Breakout
Breakout.description:
Within {Tunable.S20P03.RequiredDistance}m of a carried Survivor:
  • You gain {Tunable.S20P03.Haste%}% {Keyword.Haste}.
  • The carried Survivor wiggles {Tunable.S20P03.ExtraWiggle%}% faster.

Brutal_Strength.name: Brutal Strength
Brutal_Strength.description: You basic-break Pallets and Breakable Walls, and damage Generators {Tunable.K01P02.ActionSpeed%}% faster.

BuckleUp.name: Buckle Up
BuckleUp.description:
While healing a downed Survivor, you both see the Killer's Aura.

Whenever you finish healing a downed Survivor or fully recover:
  • The Survivor gains {Tunable.S17P02.Haste%}% {Keyword.Haste} for {Tunable.S17P02.HasteDuration}s.
  • The Survivor leaves no Scratch Marks for {Tunable.S17P02.HasteDuration}s.

BuiltToLast.name: Built to Last
BuiltToLast.description:
While holding a depleted item, after hiding in a Locker for {Tunable.S23P03.RequiredDuration}s, it is recharged to {Tunable.S23P03.InitialRefill%}%.

Each time you recharge an item this way, it recharges {Tunable.S23P03.RefillDiminishing%}% fewer Charges.

Calm_Spirit.name: Calm Spirit
Calm_Spirit.description:
You do not scare Crows or scream.

You bless and cleanse Totems, and unlock Chests silently, and {Tunable.S04P02.ActionSpeedReduction%}% faster.

Camaraderie.name: Camaraderie
Camaraderie.description: While you are struggling on Hook, when another Survivor gets within {Tunable.S18P02.PauseDistance}m, the timer is paused for {Tunable.S18P02.PauseTimer}s.

CorruptIntervention.name: Corrupt Intervention
CorruptIntervention.description: When the trial starts, the {Tunable.K15P01.GeneratorsBlocked} farthest Generators from you are blocked for {Tunable.K15P01.GeneratorBlockDuration}s, or until you down a Survivor.

Coulrophobia.name: Coulrophobia
Coulrophobia.description:
Survivors within your Terror Radius:
  • Heal {Tunable.K12P02.HealPenalty%}% slower.
  • While healing, basic Skill Checks spin {Tunable.K12P02.SkillCheckSpeedIncrease%}% faster.

CruelConfinement.name: Cruel Limits
CruelConfinement.description:
Whenever a Generator is completed:
  • You see the Auras of all Windows for {Tunable.K17P02.BlockDuration}s.
  • All Windows are blocked for Survivors for {Tunable.K17P02.BlockDuration}s.

Dance_with_me.name: Dance With Me
Dance_with_me.description: Whenever you fast-exit a Locker, medium-vault, or fast-vault, you leave no Scratch Marks for {Tunable.S13P01.Duration}s. Cooldown: {Tunable.S13P01.Cooldown}s.

Dark_Sense.name: Dark Sense
Dark_Sense.description:
Whenever a Generator is completed, when the Killer gets within {Tunable.SG_Dark_Sense.KillerRange}m of you, for {Tunable.SG_Dark_Sense.EffectDuration}s:
  • You see the Auras of Pallets and Windows within {Tunable.SG_Dark_Sense.AuraRange}m.
  • You see the Auras of other Survivors.
  • You see the Killer's Aura.

DarkDevotion.name: Dark Devotion
DarkDevotion.description:
Whenever the Obsession takes damage, for {Tunable.K15P03.TerrorRadiusTransferDuration}s:
  • Your Terror Radius is set to {Tunable.K15P03.TerrorRadiusSize}m.
  • The Obsession has your Terror Radius.
  • You gain {Keyword.Undetectable}.

DeadHard.name: Dead Hard
DeadHard.description:
Whenever you are unhooked, while injured and running, use {Input.ActivatableButton1}:
  • You gain {Keyword.Endurance} for {Tunable.S10P02.EnduranceDuration}s.
  • You gain {Keyword.Exhausted} for {Tunable.S10P02.ExhaustedDuration}s.

DeadMansSwitch.name: Dead Man’s Switch
DeadMansSwitch.description: Whenever you hook a Survivor, the next time any Survivor stops repairing a Generator for more than {Tunable.K19P02.GeneratorReleaseDuration}s, it is blocked for {Tunable.K19P02.GeneratorBlockDuration}s. Cooldown: {Tunable.K19P02.Cooldown}s.

Deathbound.name: Deathbound
Deathbound.description:
Whenever a Survivor finishes healing another, the healer screams. Then, until the healer takes damage, while they are at least {Tunable.K20P03.MaximumDistance}m away from the healed Survivor:
  • The healer gains {Keyword.Oblivious}.
  • The healer sees the healed Survivor's Aura.


    • This can only apply to one Survivor at a time.

DecisiveStrike.name: Decisive Strike
DecisiveStrike.description:
Until all Generators are completed, whenever you are unhooked, for the next {Tunable.S06P02.EffectDuration}s: when the Killer picks you up, once per trial, hit a Special Skill check:
  • Stun the Killer for {Tunable.S06P02.StunDuration}s.
  • Become the Obsession.


This is disabled by conspicuous actions. At the start of the trial, you are more likely to be the Obsession.

Deerstalker.name: Deerstalker
Deerstalker.description:
Every {Tunable.KG_Deerstalker.RevealTimeIntervals}s, the Survivor with the least time in chase sees your Aura for {Tunable.KG_Deerstalker.RevealDuration}s.

While a Survivor sees your Aura, you see their Aura.

Deja_Vu.name: Deja Vu
Deja_Vu.description: You see the Auras of the {Tunable.SG_Deja_Vu.GeneratorsShown} Generators closest to each other and repair them {Tunable.SG_Deja_Vu.RepairSpeed%}% faster.

Deliverance.name: Deliverance
Deliverance.description: Once per trial, when you safely unhook another Survivor, you can unhook yourself. When you unhook yourself this way, you gain {Keyword.Broken} for {Tunable.S14P02.BrokenDuration}s.

DesperateMeasures.name: Desperate Measures
DesperateMeasures.description:
For each injured, downed, or hooked Survivor:
  • You heal {Tunable.S23P02.ExtraActionSpeed%}% faster.
  • You unhook {Tunable.S23P02.ExtraActionSpeed%}% faster.

DetectivesHunch.name: Detective's Hunch
DetectivesHunch.description:
Whenever a Generator is completed, for {Tunable.S12P02.RevealDuration}s, within {Tunable.S12P02.RevealDistance}m of you:
  • You see the Auras of Chests.
  • You see the Auras of Generators.
  • You see the Auras of Totems.

Discordance.name: Discordance
Discordance.description:
Within {Tunable.K14P01.EffectRange}m of you, whenever a Generator is being repaired by at least 2 Survivors, you are alerted.

While that Generator is being repaired by at least 2 Survivors, you see its Aura. When it is no longer being repaired by at least 2 Survivors, this ends after {Tunable.K14P01.AuraLingerDuration}s.

Distortion.name: Distortion
Distortion.description:
When the trial starts, and after being chased for {Tunable.S15P03.RegainTokenDuration}s, you earn {Tunable.S15P03.TokensRegained} Token, up to {Tunable.S15P03.MaxTokens}.

While not downed, whenever the Killer attempts to see your Aura, spend {Tunable.S15P03.StartingTokenAmount} Token. Then, for the next {Tunable.S15P03.HiddenDuration}s:
  • The Killer cannot see your Aura.
  • You leave no Scratch Marks.

Distressing.name: Distressing
Distressing.description:
Survivors within your Terror Radius repair {Tunable.KG_Distressing.RepairSpeedPenalty}% slower.

Your Terror Radius is {Tunable.KG_Distressing.TerrorRadiusIncreaseSize}% larger.

Diversion.name: Diversion
Diversion.description:
After hiding for {Tunable.S14P01.RequiredChargeTime}s within the Killer's Terror Radius, while crouched and idle, use {Input.ActivatableButton1} to throw a pebble {Tunable.S14P01.ThrowDistance}m away:
  • The Killer is alerted.
  • The pebble leaves Scratch Marks.

DragonsGrip.name: Dragon’s Grip
DragonsGrip.description:
Whenever you damage a Generator, for the next {Tunable.K21P01.ActiveDuration}s, the first Survivor that repairs that Generator:
  • They scream, then you are alerted to their position for {Tunable.K21P01.AuraRevealDuration}s.
  • They gain {Keyword.Exposed} for {Tunable.K21P01.ExposedDuration}s.


Cooldown: {Tunable.K21P01.Cooldown}s.

Dying_Light.name: Dying Light
Dying_Light.description:
Whenever you hook a Survivor that is not the Obsession, earn {Tunable.K06P02.TokensPerHook} token.

While the Obsession is alive, for each Token:
  • Other Survivors heal {Tunable.K06P02.ActionSpeedPenaltyPerToken%}% slower.
  • Other Survivors repair {Tunable.K06P02.ActionSpeedPenaltyPerToken%}% slower.
  • Other Survivors sabotage Hooks {Tunable.K06P02.ActionSpeedPenaltyPerToken%}% slower.


The Obsession:
  • Heals other Survivors {Tunable.K06P02.ObsessionActionSpeedBonus%}% faster.
  • Unhooks other Survivors {Tunable.K06P02.ObsessionActionSpeedBonus%}% faster.

Empathy.name: Empathy
Empathy.description: Within {Tunable.S03P01.AuraRevealDistance}m, you see the Auras of injured Survivors.

Enduring.name: Enduring
Enduring.description: While not carrying a Survivor, Pallet-stuns are {Tunable.K03P01.StunDurationReduction%}% shorter.

FireUp.name: Fire Up
FireUp.description:
Whenever a Generator is completed, earn {Tunable.K10P01.TokensPerGenerator} Token, up to {Tunable.K10P01.MaxTokens}.

For each Token:
  • You basic-break Pallets and Breakable Walls {Tunable.K10P01.ActionSpeedBonus%}% faster.
  • You damage Generators {Tunable.K10P01.ActionSpeedBonus%}% faster.
  • You pick-up and drop Survivors {Tunable.K10P01.ActionSpeedBonus%}% faster.
  • You basic-vault Windows {Tunable.K10P01.ActionSpeedBonus%}% faster.

Fixated.name: Fixated
Fixated.description:
While walking, you gain {Tunable.S19P02.Haste%}% {Keyword.Haste}.

You see your own Scratch Marks.

FlipFlop.name: Flip-Flop
FlipFlop.description: While downed, whenever the Killer picks you up, {Tunable.S17P01.RecoveryRatio%}% of your recovery progress is added to your wiggle progress, up to {Tunable.S17P01.MaxWiggle%}%.

ForcedPenance.name: Forced Penance
ForcedPenance.description: Whenever a Survivor takes a protection hit, they gain {Keyword.Broken} for {Tunable.K20P01.BrokenDuration}s.

ForThePeople.name: For the People
ForThePeople.description:
While healthy and healing another Survivor without a Med-Kit, use {Input.ActivatableButton1} to heal them instantly:
  • You take damage.
  • You gain {Keyword.Broken} for {Tunable.S21P03.BrokenDuration}s.
  • You become the Obsession.


When the trial starts, you are less likely to be the Obsession.

FranklinsLoss.name: Franklin's Demise
FranklinsLoss.description:
Whenever you damage a Survivor with a basic-attack, they drop their item.

Within {Tunable.K09P03.ItemsRevealDistance}m, you see the Auras of dropped items.

FurtiveChase.name: Furtive Chase
FurtiveChase.description:
Whenever you hook the Obsession:
  • You gain {Tunable.K16P03.Haste%}% {Keyword.Haste} for {Tunable.K16P03.UndetectableHasteDuration}s.
  • You gain {Keyword.Undetectable} for {Tunable.K16P03.UndetectableHasteDuration}s.


Whenever the Obsession is unhooked, the Survivor who unhooked them becomes the Obsession.

Gearhead.name: Gearhead
Gearhead.description: Whenever a Survivor takes damage, for the next {Tunable.K19P01.EffectDuration}s, whenever a Survivor repairing a Generator hits a good basic Skill Check, you see their Aura for {Tunable.K19P01.AuraRevealDuration}s.

GeneratorOvercharge.name: Overcharge
GeneratorOvercharge.description:
Whenever you damage a Generator:
  • Its regression speed will go from {Tunable.K07P03.StartingRegressionSpeed%}% to {Tunable.K07P03.MaxRegressionSpeed%}% over the next {Tunable.K07P03.RegressionRampDuration}s.
  • The next Survivor who starts repairing it gets a special Skill Check. If they miss it, they lose {Tunable.K07P03.GenRegressionOnFail%}% more progress.

HangmansTrick.name: Scourge Hook: Hangman's Trick
HangmansTrick.description:
When the trial starts, 4 random Hooks become Scourge Hooks.

While carrying a Survivor, you see the Auras of Survivors within {Tunable.K11P01.AuraRevealDistance}m of Scourge Hooks.

Whenever a Survivor starts sabotaging a Hook, you are alerted.

HeadOn.name: Head On
HeadOn.description: After hiding in a Locker for {Tunable.S16P03.HideRequiredDuration}s, fast-exit to stun the Killer for {Tunable.S16P03.LockerStunDuration}s if they are within {Tunable.S16P03.LockerStunRange}m, then gain {Keyword.Exhausted} for {Tunable.S16P03.ExhaustedDuration}s.

Hex_Devour_Hope.name: Hex: Devour Hope
Hex_Devour_Hope.description:
When the trial starts, a Dull Totem ignites.

Whenever a Survivor is unhooked while you are at least {Tunable.K05P03.DistanceFromHook}m away, earn {Tunable.K05P03.TokensPerUnhook} Token, up to {Tunable.K05P03.MaxTokens}:
  • 2 Tokens | {Tunable.K05P03.HasteDelayDuration}s after hooking a Survivor, gain {Tunable.K05P03.Haste%}% {Keyword.Haste} for {Tunable.K05P03.HasteDuration}s.
  • 3 Tokens | Survivors gain {Keyword.Exposed}.
  • 5 Tokens | You can Kill downed Survivors.

Hex_HauntedGround.name: Hex: Haunted Ground
Hex_HauntedGround.description:
When the trial starts, 2 Dull Totems ignite.

When either of those Hex Totems is blessed or cleansed:
  • All Survivors gain {Keyword.Exposed} for {Tunable.K13P02.ExposedDuration}s.
  • The other Totem is extinguished.

Hex_HuntressLullaby.name: Hex: Huntress Lullaby
Hex_HuntressLullaby.description:
When the trial starts, a Dull Totem ignites.

Whenever you hook a Survivor, earn {Tunable.K08P03.TokensPerHook} Token. For each Token, Basic Skill Check warnings appear later and good success zones are smaller.

While you have 5 Tokens, Basic Skill Check warnings don't appear.

Whenever a Survivor misses a basic Skill Check, they lose {Tunable.K08P03.RegressionBonus%}% more progress.

Hex_Ruin.name: Hex: Ruin
Hex_Ruin.description:
When the trial starts, a Dull Totem ignites.

While a Generator is not being repaired, it regresses at {Tunable.K05P02.RegressionSpeed%}% speed.

Hex_The_Third_Seal.name: Hex: The Third Seal
Hex_The_Third_Seal.description:
When the trial starts, a Dull Totem ignites.

Whenever you damage a Survivor with a basic or special-attack, they gain {Keyword.Blindness}.

This applies for up to {Tunable.K05P01.MaxAffectedSurvivors} Survivors.

Hex_Thrill_Of_The_Hunt.name: Hex: Thrill of the Hunt
Hex_Thrill_Of_The_Hunt.description:
The first time you hook a Survivor, a Dull Totem ignites.


When you hook a Survivor, block all Hex Totems for {Tunable.KG_Hex_Thrill_Of_The_Hunt.BlockDurationPerToken}s for each lit Hex Totem.

HexBloodFavor.name: Hex: Blood Favor
HexBloodFavor.description:
When the trial starts, a Dull Totem ignites.

Whenever a healthy Survivor becomes injured by your basic-attack, Upright Pallets within {Tunable.K21P03.EffectRadius}m of them are blocked for {Tunable.K21P03.BlockDuration}s.

HexRetribution.name: Hex: Retribution
HexRetribution.description:
When the trial starts, a Dull Totem ignites.

Whenever a Survivor starts blessing or cleansing a Totem, they gain {Keyword.Oblivious} for {Tunable.K19P03.ObliviousDuration}s.

Whenever a Hex Totem is blessed or cleansed, you see the Auras of all Survivors for {Tunable.K19P03.AuraRevealDuration}s.

HexUndying.name: Hex: Undying
HexUndying.description:
When the trial starts, a Dull Totem ignites.

When another Hex Totem is blessed or cleansed, it replaces this one and keeps any Tokens it had.

You see the Auras of Survivors within {Tunable.K21P02.AuraRevealDistance}m of Dull Totems.

Hope.name: Hope
Hope.description: When all Generators are completed, you gain {Tunable.SG_Hope.Haste%}% {Keyword.Haste}.

ImAllEars.name: I'm All Ears
ImAllEars.description: Whenever a Survivor fast-enters or fast-exits a Locker, or medium or fast-vaults within {Tunable.K16P01.ActivationRange}m of you, you see their Aura for {Tunable.K16P01.AuraRevealDuration}s. Cooldown: {Tunable.K16P01.Cooldown}s.

InfectiousFright.name: Infectious Fright
InfectiousFright.description: Whenever a Survivor is downed, Survivors within your Terror Radius scream and you are alerted for {Tunable.K15P02.RevealDuration}s.

InnerStrength.name: Inner Strength
InnerStrength.description: Whenever you cleanse a Totem, while injured and not {Keyword.Broken}, after hiding in a Locker for {Tunable.S19P03.HideDuration}s, you become healthy instantly.

Insidious.name: Insidious
Insidious.description: After being idle for {Tunable.KG_Insidious.TimeToActivate}s, gain {Keyword.Undetectable}. Whenever you act, this ends after {Tunable.KG_Insidious.LingerTime}s.

InTheDark.name: Knock Out
InTheDark.description:
Whenever a Survivor drops a Pallet, for the next {Tunable.K09P01.TriggerTime}s, if they move {Tunable.K09P01.DistanceThreshold}m away from it, they gain {Tunable.K09P01.Hindered%}% {Keyword.Hindered} for {Tunable.K09P01.HinderedDuration}s.


This ends early if the Pallet is broken.

Iron_Grasp.name: Iron Grasp
Iron_Grasp.description:
While carrying a Survivor:
  • They wiggle {Tunable.KG_Iron_Grasp.WiggleTimeIncrease%}% slower.
  • Their wiggle is {Tunable.KG_Iron_Grasp.WiggleStrengthReduction%}% weaker.

Iron_Will.name: Iron Will
Iron_Will.description: While injured and not {Keyword.Exhausted}, your Grunts of Pain are {Tunable.S04P01.InjuredNoiseReduction%}% quieter.

Ironmaiden.name: Iron Maiden
Ironmaiden.description:
Whenever a Survivor exits a Locker:
  • They gain {Keyword.Exposed} for {Tunable.K14P03.ExposedDuration}s.
  • They scream, then you are alerted to their location for {Tunable.K14P03.RevealDuration}s.


You open Lockers {Tunable.K14P03.ActionSpeed%}% faster.

K22P01.name: Hoarder
K22P01.description:
When the trial starts, {Tunable.K22P01.ExtraChestsSpawned} more Chests appear.

Whenever a Survivor picks-up an Item or starts unlocking a Chest within {Tunable.K22P01.RevealDistance}m of you, you are alerted.

K22P02.name: Oppression
K22P02.description: Whenever you damage a Generator, up to {Tunable.K22P02.AffectedGenerators} other Generators start regressing. Survivors repairing them get a special Skill Check. Cooldown: {Tunable.K22P02.Cooldown}s.

K22P03.name: Coup de Grâce
K22P03.description:
Whenever a Generator is completed, you earn {Tunable.K22P03.TokensGainedPerGenerator} Tokens, up to {Tunable.K22P03.MaxTokens}.

Whenever you lunge-attack, spend {Tunable.K22P03.TokensSpentPerLunge} Token to make it {Tunable.K22P03.LungeExtraDuration%}% longer.

K23P01.name: Starstruck
K23P01.description:
While carrying a Survivor, Survivors within your Terror Radius gain {Keyword.Exposed}. This ends {Tunable.K23P01.ExposedLingerDuration}s after:
  • They leave your Terror Radius.
  • You drop or Hook the carried Survivor.


Cooldown: {Tunable.K23P01.Cooldown}s.

K23P02.name: Hex: Crowd Control
K23P02.description:
The first time a Survivor medium or fast-vaults a Window, a Dull Totem ignites.

The last {Tunable.K23P02.MaximumVaultsBlocked} Windows Survivors medium or fast-vault are blocked.

You basic-vault blocked Windows {Tunable.K23P02.VaultSpeedIncrease%}% faster.

You see the Auras of blocked Windows within {Tunable.K23P02.AuraRevealDistance}m.

K23P03.name: No Way Out
K23P03.description:
The first time you Hook each Survivor, you earn {Tunable.K23P03.TokensPerUniqueHook} Token.

When all Generators are completed, when a Survivor starts opening an Exit Gate:
  • It is blocked {Tunable.K23P03.GateBlockBaseDuration}s, plus {Tunable.K23P03.GateBlockDurationPerToken}s for each Token.
  • You are alerted.

K24P01.name: Lethal Pursuer
K24P01.description:
When the trial starts, you see the Auras of all Survivors for {Tunable.K24P01.AuraRevealDuration}s.

Whenever you see a Survivor's Aura for a duration, it is {Tunable.K24P01.BonusAuraRevealDuration}s longer.

K24P02.name: Hysteria
K24P02.description: Whenever a healthy Survivor becomes injured, all injured Survivors gain {Keyword.Oblivious} for {Tunable.K24P02.ObliviousDuration}s. Cooldown: {Tunable.K24P02.Cooldown}s.

K24P03.name: Eruption
K24P03.description:
Whenever you damage a Generator, when you down a Survivor, all Generators damaged this way:
  • Explode, lose {Tunable.K24P03.GeneratorRegress%}% progress and start regressing.
  • Survivors repairing them scream, then you see their Auras for {Tunable.K24P03.AuraRevealDuration}s.


Cooldown: {Tunable.K24P03.Cooldown}s.

K25P01.name: Deadlock
K25P01.description: Whenever a Generator is completed, the Generator with the most progress is blocked for {Tunable.K25P01.GeneratorBlockDuration}s.

K25P02.name: Hex: Plaything
K25P02.description:
The first time you hook each Survivor, they are hexed and a Dull Totem ignites.

For {Tunable.K25P02.TotemBlockDuration}s, the Hex Totem is blocked to other Survivors.

The hexed Survivors:

  • Gain {Keyword.Oblivious}.
  • Within {Tunable.K25P02.TotemAuraRevealDistance}m of the Hex Totem, they see its Aura.

K25P03.name: Scourge Hook: Gift of Pain
K25P03.description:
When the trial starts, 4 random Hooks become Scourge Hooks.

Whenever a Survivor is unhooked from a Scourge Hook:
  • They gain {Keyword.Hemorrhage} for {Tunable.K25P03.MangledHemorrhageDuration}s.
  • They gain {Keyword.Mangled} for {Tunable.K25P03.MangledHemorrhageDuration}s.
  • When they are healed, until they take damage, they heal and repair {Tunable.K25P03.ActionSpeedDebuff%}% slower.

K26P01.name: Grim Embrace
K26P01.description:
Whenever you Hook a Survivor for the first time, earn {Tunable.K26P01.TokensPerUniqueHook} Token.

When you move {Tunable.K26P01.HookedDistance}m away from the hooked Survivor, all Generators are blocked for {Tunable.K26P01.GeneratorBlockDuration}s.

When you have {Tunable.K26P01.SurvivorsToBeHooked} Tokens, when you move {Tunable.K26P01.HookedDistance}m away from the hooked Survivor:
  • All Generators are blocked for {Tunable.K26P01.FinalGeneratorBlockDuration}s.
  • You see the Obsession's Aura for {Tunable.K26P01.AuraRevealDuration}s.

K26P02.name: Scourge Hook: Pain Resonance
K26P02.description:
When the trial starts:
  • 4 random Hooks become Scourge Hooks.
  • You earn {Tunable.K26P02.StartingTokens} Tokens.


The first time each Survivor is hooked on a Scourge Hook, spend {Tunable.K26P02.TokensSpentOnUniqueHook} Token, then the Generator with the most progress:
  • Explodes, loses {Tunable.K26P02.GeneratorRegression%}% progress and starts regressing.
  • Survivors repairing it scream.

K26P03.name: Hex: Pentimento
K26P03.description:
You see the Auras of cleansed Totems, and can rekindle each once.

Within {Tunable.K26P03.TotemAuraReveaDistance}m, Survivors see the Auras of Rekindled Totems.

While a Totem is rekindled, Survivors heal and repair {Tunable.K26P03.BaseActionSpeedPenalty%}% slower, plus {Tunable.K26P03.ActionSpeedPenaltyPerTotem%}% for each additional Rekindled Totem.

When all {Tunable.K26P03.MaxTokens} Totems are rekindled at once, they are blocked.

K27P01.name: Scourge Hook: Floods of Rage
K27P01.description:
When the trial starts, 4 random Hooks become Scourge Hooks.

Whenever a Survivor is unhooked from a Scourge Hook, you see the Auras of other Survivors for {Tunable.K27P01.AuraRevealDuration}s.

K27P02.name: Call of Brine
K27P02.description:
Whenever you damage a Generator, it regresses {Tunable.K27P02.RegressionModifier%}% faster for {Tunable.K27P02.Duration}s.

For that time, whenever a Survivor hits a good basic Skill Check while repairing that Generator, you are alerted.

K27P03.name: Merciless Storm
K27P03.description: The first time each Generator has {Tunable.K27P03.GeneratorProgressionRequired%}% progress: Survivors repairing it get special Skill Checks. If they miss one of these or stop repairing, that Generator is blocked for {Tunable.K27P03.GeneratorBlockedDuration}s.

K28P01.name: Dissolution
K28P01.description: {Tunable.K28P01.TimeBeforeTrigger}s after a Survivor takes damage from a basic-attack, for {Tunable.K28P01.EffectDuration}s, the next time a Survivor fast-vaults a Pallet while within your Terror Radius, it is destroyed.

K28P02.name: Darkness Revealed
K28P02.description: Whenever you search a Locker, you see the Auras of Survivors within {Tunable.K28P02.DetectionDistance}m of Lockers for {Tunable.K28P02.AuraRevealDuration}s. Cooldown: {Tunable.K28P02.Cooldown}s.

K28P03.name: Septic Touch
K28P03.description:
While a Survivor within your Terror Radius is healing:
  • They gain {Keyword.Blindness}.
  • They gain {Keyword.Exhausted}.


When they stop healing, this ends after {Tunable.K28P03.BlindnessExhaustionDuration}s.

K29P01.name: Superior Anatomy
K29P01.description: Whenever a Survivor medium or fast-vaults within {Tunable.K29P01.SurvivorVaultDistance}m of you, the next time you basic-vault a Window, you basic-vault Windows {Tunable.K29P01.VaultSpeed%}% faster for {Tunable.K29P01.VaultSpeedDuration}s. Cooldown: {Tunable.K29P01.Cooldown}s.

K29P02.name: Awakened Awareness
K29P02.description: While carrying a Survivor, within {Tunable.K29P02.AuraRevealDistance}m of you, you see the Auras of other Survivors.

K29P03.name: Terminus
K29P03.description:
When all Generators are completed: all injured, downed, and hooked Survivors gain {Keyword.Broken}.

When an Exit Gate is opened, this ends after {Tunable.K29P03.BrokenDuration}s.

K30P01.name: Nowhere to Hide
K30P01.description: Whenever you damage a Generator, for {Tunable.K30P01.AuraRevealDuration}s, you see the Auras of Survivors within {Tunable.K30P01.AuraRevealDistance}m of it.

K30P02.name: Hex: Face the Darkness
K30P02.description:
Whenever you damage a Survivor, they are hexed and a Dull Totem ignites.

Every {Tunable.K30P02.ScreamInterval}s, other Survivors not within your Terror Radius scream, then you see their Auras for {Tunable.K30P02.AuraRevealDuration}s.

When the hexed Survivor is downed or becomes healthy, the Hex Totem is extinguished.

K30P03.name: Hubris
K30P03.description: Whenever you are stunned by a Survivor, they gain {Keyword.Exposed} for {Tunable.K30P03.ExposedDuration}s. Cooldown: {Tunable.K30P03.Cooldown}s.

K31P01.name: Game Afoot
K31P01.description:
While chasing the Obsession, whenever you basic-break Pallets or Breakable Walls, or damage Generators, you gain {Tunable.K31P01.Haste%}% {Keyword.Haste} for {Tunable.K31P01.HasteDuration}s.

Whenever you damage the Survivor with the most chase time with a basic-attack, they become the Obsession.

K31P02.name: THWACK!
K31P02.description:
When the trial starts, you earn {Tunable.K31P02.StartingTokens} Tokens, up to {Tunable.K31P02.MaxTokens}.

Whenever you hook a Survivor, you earn {Tunable.K31P02.TokenGainOnHook} Token.

Whenever you break a Pallet or Breakable Wall, spend {Tunable.K31P02.TokensSpentPerBreak} Token. Then, all Survivors within {Tunable.K31P02.Range}m scream and you see their Auras for {Tunable.K31P02.RevealDuration}s.

K31P03.name: Leverage
K31P03.description: Whenever a Survivor unhooks another or themselves, they heal {Tunable.K31P03.HealPenalty%}% slower for {Tunable.K31P03.ReduceHealingDuration}s.

K32P01.name: Genetic Limits
K32P01.description: Whenever a Survivor takes damage, they gain {Keyword.Exhausted} for {Tunable.K32P01.ExhaustionDuration}s.

K32P02.name: Forced Hesitation
K32P02.description: Whenever you down a Survivor, other Survivors within {Tunable.K32P02.RequiredDistance}m of the downed Survivor gain {Tunable.K32P02.Hinder%}% {Keyword.Hindered} for {Tunable.K32P02.HinderedDuration}s. Cooldown: {Tunable.K32P02.Cooldown}s.

K32P03.name: Machine Learning
K32P03.description:
Whenever you damage a Generator, it becomes compromised.

When any compromised Generator is completed by Survivors:
  • You gain {Tunable.K32P03.Haste%}% {Keyword.Haste} for {Tunable.K32P03.PerkDuration}s.
  • You gain {Keyword.Undetectable} for {Tunable.K32P03.PerkDuration}s.
  • Other Generators lose compromised.


Up to {Tunable.K32P03.GeneratorsCompromised} Generators can be compromised at a time.

K33P01.name: Ultimate Weapon
K33P01.description:
Whenever you search a Locker, Survivors within {Tunable.K33P01.RequiredDistance}m:
  • Gain {Keyword.Blindness} for {Tunable.K33P01.BlindnessDuration}s.
  • Scream.


Cooldown: {Tunable.K33P01.Cooldown}s.

K33P02.name: Rapid Brutality
K33P02.description:
Whenever you damage a Survivor with a basic-attack, you gain {Tunable.K33P02.Haste%}% {Keyword.Haste} for {Tunable.K33P02.HasteDuration}s.

While chasing a Survivor, you cannot gain Bloodlust.

K33P03.name: Alien Instinct
K33P03.description:
Whenever you hook a Survivor, the farthest injured Survivor:
  • Gains {Keyword.Oblivious} for {Tunable.K33P03.ObliviousDuration}s.
  • You see their Aura for {Tunable.K33P03.AuraRevealDuration}s.

K34P01.name: Hex: Two Can Play
K34P01.description:
While this Hex is dull, each time you are blinded or stunned by a Survivor {Tunable.K34P01.StunnedOrBlindedTimesRequired} times, a Dull Totem ignites.

Whenever you are blinded or stunned by a Survivor you are not carrying, they are blinded for {Tunable.K34P01.BlindedDuration}s.

K34P02.name: Friends ‘Til the End
K34P02.description:
Whenever you Hook a Survivor that is not the Obsession:
  • The Obsession gains {Keyword.Exposed} for {Tunable.K34P02.ExposedDuration}s.
  • You see the Obsession's Aura for {Tunable.K34P02.AuraRevealDuration}s.


Whenever you Hook the Obsession, another Survivor:
  • Screams, then you are alerted.
  • Becomes the Obsession.

K34P03.name: Batteries Included
K34P03.description: Within {Tunable.K34P03.RequiredDistance}m of a completed Generator, you gain {Tunable.K34P03.Haste%}% {Keyword.Haste}. When you leave the range, this ends after {Tunable.K34P03.HasteLingerDuration}s.

K35P01.name: Unbound
K35P01.description: Whenever a healthy Survivor becomes injured, for the next {Tunable.K35P01.EffectDuration}s, whenever you basic-vault a window, gain {Tunable.K35P01.Haste%}% {Keyword.Haste} for {Tunable.K35P01.HasteDuration}s.

K35P02.name: Unforeseen
K35P02.description:
Whenever you damage a Generator:
  • Your Terror Radius is set to that Generator for {Tunable.K35P02.EffectDuration}s and its radius is {Tunable.K35P02.TerrorRadiusSize}m.
  • You gain {Keyword.Undetectable} for that time.


Cooldown: {Tunable.K35P02.Cooldown}s.

K35P03.name: Undone
K35P03.description:
Whenever you hook a Survivor, earn {Tunable.K35P03.TokenGain} Token, up to {Tunable.K35P03.MaxTokens}.

Whenever you damage a Generator, spend all Tokens. For each Token spent:
  • The Generator loses {Tunable.K35P03.GeneratorRegressionPerToken%}% more progress.
  • The Generator is blocked for {Tunable.K35P03.BlockTimePerToken}s.

K36P01.name: Weave Attunement
K36P01.description:
The first time each item is depleted, it is dropped.

While a Survivor is within {Tunable.K36P01.AuraRevealDistance}m of a dropped item:
  • You see their Aura.
  • They see the item's Aura.


Whenever a Survivor picks-up an item, they gain {Keyword.Oblivious} for {Tunable.K36P01.ObliviousDuration}s.

K36P02.name: Languid Touch
K36P02.description: Whenever a Survivor within {Tunable.K36P02.RangeFromKiller}m of you scares a Crow, they gain {Keyword.Exhausted} for {Tunable.K36P02.ExhaustedDuration}s. Cooldown: {Tunable.K36P02.Cooldown}s.

K36P03.name: Dark Arrogance
K36P03.description:
You basic-vault Windows {Tunable.K36P03.VaultSpeedIncrease%}% faster.

Your missed basic-attack cooldown is {Tunable.K36P03.AttackCooldownReduction%}% shorter.

Whenever you are blinded or Pallet-stunned, the duration is {Tunable.K36P03.ExtraBlindStunDuration%}% longer.

K37P01.name: Hex: Wretched Fate
K37P01.description:
The first time a Generator is completed, a Dull Totem ignites.

The Obsession:
  • Repairs {Tunable.K37P01.RepairSpeedPenalty%}% slower.
  • Sees the Hex Totem's Aura within {Tunable.K37P01.AuraRevealDistance}m.

K37P02.name: Human Greed
K37P02.description:
Whenever a Survivor gets within {Tunable.K37P02.AuraRevealRange}m of a locked Chest, you see their Aura for {Tunable.K37P02.AuraRevealDuration}s.

You can lock unlocked Chests. Cooldown: {Tunable.K37P02.Cooldown}s.

You see the Auras of locked Chests.

K37P03.name: Dominance
K37P03.description:
The first time each Totem is being blessed or cleansed by a Survivor:
  • It is blocked for {Tunable.K37P03.BlockDuration}s.
  • They scream.
  • You see their Aura for {Tunable.K37P03.AuraDuration}s.

K38P01.name: All-Shaking Thunder
K38P01.description: Whenever you fall from at least {Tunable.K38P01.RequiredFallHeight}m, your lunge-attacks are {Tunable.K38P01.LungeAttackExtra%}% longer for {Tunable.K38P01.EffectDuration}s. Cooldown: {Tunable.K38P01.Cooldown}s.

K38P02.name: Scourge Hook: Jagged Compass
K38P02.description:
When the trial starts, 4 random Hooks become Scourge Hooks.

Whenever a Survivor is unhooked, the Hook becomes a Scourge Hook.

Whenever you hook a Survivor on a Scourge Hook, for {Tunable.K38P02.GeneratorRevealDuration}s, you see the Aura of the Generator with the most progress.

K38P03.name: No Quarter
K38P03.description: While self-healing, whenever a Survivor has {Tunable.K38P03.SelfHealTrigger%}% progress, they get special Skill Checks. If they miss one of these or stop healing, they gain {Keyword.Broken} for {Tunable.K38P03.BrokenDuration}s.

K39P01.name: Hex: Nothing But Misery
K39P01.description:
After you damage Survivors with a basic-attack {Tunable.K39P01.BasicHitsRequired} times, a Dull Totem ignites.

Whenever you damage a Survivor with a basic-attack:
  • They gain {Tunable.K39P01.Hindered%}% {Keyword.Hindered} for {Tunable.K39P01.HinderedDuration}s.
  • They vault {Tunable.K39P01.Vault%}% slower for {Tunable.K39P01.VaultDuration}s.

K39P02.name: Forever Entwined
K39P02.description:
Whenever a Survivor takes damage, you earn {Tunable.K39P02.TokensPerDamage} Token, up to {Tunable.K39P02.MaxTokens}.

For each Token:
  • You hook Survivors {Tunable.K39P02.BonusPerToken%}% faster.
  • You pick-up and drop Survivors {Tunable.K39P02.BonusPerToken%}% faster.

K39P03.name: None Are Free
K39P03.description:
The first time you hook each Survivor, earn {Tunable.K39P03.TokensPerUniqueHook} Token.

When all Generators are completed, for each Token:
  • Upright Pallets are blocked for {Tunable.K39P03.BlockDurationPerToken}s.
  • Windows are blocked for {Tunable.K39P03.BlockDurationPerToken}s.

K40P01.name: Help Wanted
K40P01.description:
Whenever you damage a Generator, it is compromised.

When any compromised Generator is completed by Survivors:
  • Your successful basic-attack cooldowns are {Tunable.K40P01.AttackCooldownReduction%}% shorter for {Tunable.K40P01.Duration}s.
  • Generators not being repaired regress at {Tunable.K40P01.RegressionSpeed%}% speed for {Tunable.K40P01.Duration}s.
  • Other Generators lose compromised.


    • Up to {Tunable.K40P01.GeneratorsCompromised} Generators can be compromised at a time.

K40P02.name: Phantom Fear
K40P02.description: Whenever a Survivor within your Terror Radius looks at you, they scream, then you see their Aura for {Tunable.K40P02.AuraRevealDuration}s. Cooldown: {Tunable.K40P02.Cooldown}s.

K40P03.name: Haywire
K40P03.description:
Exit Gate Switches with at least {Tunable.K40P03.RegressionThreshold%}% progress regress at {Tunable.K40P03.RegressionRate%}% speed.

While they are regressing, Survivors see the Exit Gate Lights flicker randomly.

K41P01.name: Ravenous
K41P01.description:
The first time you hook each Survivor, you earn {Tunable.K41P01.TokensPerUniqueHook} Token. For each Token:
  • Gain {Tunable.K41P01.CarryHaste%PerToken}% {Keyword.Haste} while carrying a Survivor.
  • Hook Survivors {Tunable.K41P01.HookFaster%PerToken}% faster.


    • When you have {Tunable.K41P01.MaxTokens} Tokens, all Survivors:
  • Scream.
  • Gain {Keyword.Exposed} for {Tunable.K41P01.ExposedDuration}s.

K41P02.name: Wandering Eye
K41P02.description: Whenever you start chasing a Survivor, for the next {Tunable.K41P02.RevealDuration}s, you see the Auras of all other injured Survivors within {Tunable.K41P02.RevealDistance}m. Cooldown: {Tunable.K41P02.Cooldown}s.

K41P03.name: Hex: Overture of Doom
K41P03.description:
When the trial starts, a Dull Totem ignites and hexes the farthest Generator from it.

After a Survivor repairs the hexed Generator for {Tunable.K41P03.RequiredTime} seconds:
  • You gain {Keyword.Undetectable} for {Tunable.K41P03.TerrorRadiusDisplacementDuration}s.
  • For that time, your Terror Radius is set to that Generator.


When the hexed Generator is repaired, the next farthest Generator is hexed.

K42P01.name: Turn Back The Clock
K42P01.description: After hooking a Survivor, for the next {Tunable.K42P01.Duration}s, use {Input.ActivatableButton1} to make target Generator you can see within {Tunable.K42P01.Range}m explode, lose {Tunable.K42P01.GeneratorRegression%}% progress and start regressing.

K42P02.name: Secret Project
K42P02.description:
Whenever a Totem is blessed or cleansed, a random unblocked Generator is blocked for {Tunable.K42P02.BlockDuration}s.

Whenever 1 or more Generators are blocked, you gain {Keyword.Undetectable} for {Tunable.K42P02.UndetectableDuration}s.

K42P03.name: Hex: Hive Mind
K42P03.description:
The first time you hook a Survivor, a Dull Totem ignites.

The Auras of Generators show their progress.

When {Tunable.K42P03.GeneratorsToActivate} Generator remains:
  • All Generators explode, lose {Tunable.K42P03.GeneratorRegression%}% progress and start regressing.
  • The Hex Totem is extinguished.

K43P01.name: Hex: Scared to Death
K43P01.description:
After you hook {Tunable.K43P01.UniqueSurvivorsToHook} different Survivors, a Dull Totem ignites.

While chasing a Survivor, whenever you basic-break a Pallet, Survivors within {Tunable.K43P01.DistanceToSurvivors}m:
  • Scream.
  • Gain {Tunable.K43P01.HinderedValue}% {Keyword.Hindered} for {Tunable.K43P01.HinderedDuration}s.

K43P02.name: Silent Shadow
K43P02.description:
Whenever you hook a Survivor, you gain {Keyword.Undetectable} for {Tunable.K43P02.StartTrialUndetectableDuration}s.

When all Generators are completed, you gain {Keyword.Undetectable}.

K43P03.name: Rampage
K43P03.description:
Whenever you basic-break a Pallet or Breakable Wall, you earn {Tunable.K43P03.TokensGained} Token, up to {Tunable.K43P03.TokensMaximum}.

Whenever you are blinded or Pallet-stunned, for the next {Tunable.K43P03.HasteDuration}s you gain {Tunable.K43P03.HasteValue}% {Keyword.Haste} for each Token. Cooldown: {Tunable.K43P03.Cooldown}.

K44P01.name: Celestial Witness
K44P01.description: Every {Tunable.K044P01.Timer}s, if the Obsession is at least {Tunable.K044P01.Distance}m away from you, you see their Aura for {Tunable.K044P01.AuraDuration}s. Otherwise, the farthest Survivor becomes the Obsession.

K44P02.name: Hex: Under Your Thumb
K44P02.description:
The first time a Survivor gains a Hook State, a Dull Totem ignites.

Whenever a running Survivor gains {Keyword.Haste} within {Tunable.K044P02.HasteRange}m of you, you are alerted.

Running Survivors cannot gain more than {Tunable.K044P02.HasteCap}% {Keyword.Haste} at a time.

K44P03.name: Lay Waste
K44P03.description: Whenever you damage a Generator, for each Charge it has, it regresses {Tunable.K044P03.FasterRegression}% faster. Cooldown: {Tunable.K044P03.Cooldown}s.

Kindred.name: Kindred
Kindred.description:
While you are hooked, all Survivors see each others' Auras. While the Killer is within {Tunable.SG_Kindred.AuraRevealDistance}m, all Survivors sees the Killer's Aura.

While another Survivor is hooked, you see the Auras of other Survivors. While the Killer is within {Tunable.SG_Kindred.AuraRevealDistance}m of the hooked Survivor, you see the Killer's Aura.

Leader.name: Leader
Leader.description:
Within {Tunable.S01P02.Range}m of you, other Survivors:
  • Cleanse Totems {Tunable.S01P02.ActionSpeedModifier%}% faster.
  • Heal {Tunable.S01P02.ActionSpeedModifier%}% faster.
  • Open Exit Gates {Tunable.S01P02.ActionSpeedModifier%}% faster.
  • Sabotage Hooks {Tunable.S01P02.ActionSpeedModifier%}% faster.
  • Unhook Survivors {Tunable.S01P02.ActionSpeedModifier%}% faster.
  • Unlock Chests {Tunable.S01P02.ActionSpeedModifier%}% faster.


After they leave your range, this ends after {Tunable.S01P02.LingerDuration}s.

LeftBehind.name: Left Behind
LeftBehind.description: When all other Survivors are dead, while within {Tunable.S08P01.HatchRevealDistance}m of the Hatch, you see its Aura.

Lightborn.name: Lightborn
Lightborn.description:
Whenever a Survivor attempts to blind you, you see their Aura for {Tunable.K03P02.AuraRevealDuration}s.

You cannot be blinded.

Lightweight.name: Lightweight
Lightweight.description: Your Scratch Marks disappear {Tunable.SG_Lightweight.ScratchmarksTimeReduction}s faster and appear more spread out.

Lithe.name: Lithe
Lithe.description:
Whenever you medium or fast-vault:
  • You gain {Tunable.S09P02.Haste%}% {Keyword.Haste} for {Tunable.S09P02.HasteDuration}s.
  • You gain {Keyword.Exhausted} for {Tunable.S09P02.ExhaustionDuration}s.

LuckyBreak.name: Lucky Break
LuckyBreak.description:
While injured, for up to {Tunable.S20P01.MaxDuration}s:
  • You leave no Pools of Blood.
  • You leave no Scratch Marks.


For each second spent healing another Survivor, recharge the duration by {Tunable.S20P01.TimePerHealingSecond}s.

MadGrit.name: Mad Grit
MadGrit.description:
While carrying a Survivor:
  • Whenever you miss a basic-attack, your cooldown is {Tunable.K14P02.AttackCooldownReduction}% shorter.
  • Whenever you damage a Survivor with a basic attack, the carried Survivor gains no wiggle progress for {Tunable.K14P02.WigglePauseDuration}s.

MakeYourChoice.name: Make your Choice
MakeYourChoice.description:
Whenever a Survivor unhooks another or themselves while you are at least {Tunable.K11P03.MinimumDistance}m away:
  • They scream.
  • They gain {Keyword.Exposed} for {Tunable.K11P03.ExposedDuration}s.


Cooldown: {Tunable.K11P03.Cooldown}s.

Mindbreaker.name: Mindbreaker
Mindbreaker.description:
While Survivors are repairing a Generator:
  • They gain {Keyword.Blindness}.
  • They gain {Keyword.Exhausted}.


When they stop repairing a Generator, this ends after {Tunable.K17P03.LingerDuration}s.

MonitorAndAbuse.name: Monitor & Abuse
MonitorAndAbuse.description:
While chasing a Survivor, your Terror Radius is {Tunable.K07P02.TerrorRadiusIncrease%}% bigger.

While not chasing a Survivor, your Terror Radius is {Tunable.K07P02.TerrorRadiusDecrease%}% smaller.

Monstrous_Shrine.name: Scourge Hook: Monstrous Shrine
Monstrous_Shrine.description:
When the Trial starts:
  • 4 random Hooks become Scourge Hooks.
  • The Basement Hooks become Scourge Hooks.



While you are at least {Tunable.KG_Monstrous_Shrine.Range}m away from a Survivor on a Scourge Hook, any Generator that isn't being repaired regresses at {Tunable.KG_Monstrous_Shrine.GeneratorRegression}% speed.

Nemesis.name: Nemesis
Nemesis.description:
Whenever a Survivor blinds you, Locker-stuns or Pallet-stuns you, they become the Obsession.

Whenever a Survivor becomes the Obsession:
  • They gain {Keyword.Oblivious} for {Tunable.K18P03.ObliviousDuration}s.
  • You see their Aura for {Tunable.K18P03.AuraRevealDuration}s.

No_One_Escapes_Death.name: Hex: No One Escapes Death
No_One_Escapes_Death.description:
